umami.js in this folder is the tracker script of Umami (https://umami.is), exactly as
published at https://cloud.umami.is/script.js on 12 November 2026
(sha256 c11c9d29ac15ee26ef07059add176fd7db95acbf8e8bdb1a79796b0ffdb58f18), unchanged.
Roam serves its own copy so that no code from another site runs in the page.
How to refresh it: scripts/check-security.mjs.
